list.name: Default Changelist
list.comment: important bug fix in TCP layer - set connection state to CLOSED if there is any error while sending segment - set connection state to CLOSED if waiting for SYN ACK times-out - similar to TCP TIMED_WAIT state, timeout after 1 min if the connection remains in TCP_LAST_ACK or TCP_CLOSING state because in this case both sides have sent FIN to each other but the other side holding up the connection without sending the ACK - timeout and release the connection when in TCP_FIN_WAIT_2 state if there is no data from the other side. This is a half open connection situation - and if there is no data packets coming from the other side then close/release the connection after the time out

task.summary: Default task
save fx states and protect framebuffer copy by disabling all interrupts
save fx states and protect framebuffer copy by disabling all interrupts
enhance scheduler to support yield and preempt

Enable both APIC and PIT timer. Use APIC for process scheduling and PIT for clock/time keeping. Implement yield() for various wait scenarios. Add a schedule_runner_process that will ensure that the timer interrupt based scheduler has at-least one process to execute and return from timer irq - so, other interrupts like PIT timer interrupt will get a chance to trigger and allow sleeping processes to wake up. Basically, this will avoid the main process scheduling loop inside the timer interrupt handler from getting into an infinite loop of processes that are not ready to run.
migrating some of the graphics related APIs to 64bit
Fix scheduling to track current process separately to ensure Process and Thread context switch are handled properly
fix issue with file-read by not converting pointer to unsigned
generate kernel.ld from cmake, to replace cmake env variables in kernel.ld for absolute paths
changes to support loading user process from storage
support for system calls - built the entry point and routing logic for system calls
support for system calls - built the entry point and routing logic for system calls
inject .dll section into executable/dll image at loading time
more changes to handle syscall and dll resolution
align stack for loaded user-process to 16 byte to ensure SSE/SSE2/SSE3 instructions don't cause General Protection Fault

Remove the error-code (if any) from stack in interrupt/exception handler upfront before saving the registers to ensure rsp is 16 byte aligned. without error-code, the stack has 5 params * 8 byte = 40 bytes. Save registers will push 120 bytes for registers and 512 bytes for xxm registers - total 512 + 120 + 40 = 672 -> 16 byte aligned. Adding error-code will make rsp 680 bytes which is not 16 byte aligned, which makes fxsave fail with General Protection Fault

separate stack frame for timer vs page-fault vs rest. It is paricurlarly important to keep stack separate for time vs page-fault because page-fault handler yields by calling timer interrupt (int 0x20) and hence they can't both use same stack frame. This is achieved using different IST values in IDT definition of these interrupts
fix issue with populating main() method arguments on user stack
commented debug print statements
fix bug in ELFInfo destructor to delete the correct pointers. This was causing kernel deallocation to fail with an exception, causing infinite loop
clean up code
increase disk driver cache size to 4MB
fix the pointer type
fine tune the hard coded delays during usb initialization by reducing the delay to value slightly higher than specified in USB spec
fix address variable type to uint64_t from uint32_t
fix address/pointer type to uint64_t from uint32_t
change direct call to yield() to sleep() to ensure the process status is set to SLEEP (!= RUN) and avoid getting not preempted for running less than 10ms
code cleanup to remove unused code
fix bug in page deallocator to use page-number instead of page-address
Context switch code should run in kernel-mode. This will ensure that print statements are written to kernel stdout/terminal
processSpaceSize is same as total image size of the process that includes dll resolver

Optimize memory allocation to keep freed chunks in sorted order and then coalesce consecutive free blocks. Refactored DMM to use common code for user and kernel allocators
updated scope for project files

destroy graphicsContext for kernel by having kernel process explicitly pass the gc param. this is so because while destroying the context which happens typically while terminating the process, the code in kernel will be running in kernel-mode, during which, the process-lookup-table should be accessed to obtain the graphicsContext because the process-lookup will return kernel-root-process in kernel-mode

comment code of old algorithm for free()
